t.zh: 会做矩阵的加法和减法。

t.en: Identify when these operations are not defined.

t.en: Apply the algebraic properties of matrix addition to manipulate an algebraic expression involving matrices.

t.en: The \textbf$m\times n$ zero matrix is the $m\times n$-matrix in which all entries are equal to zero. It is denoted by $0$.
t.zh: **$m\times n$ 零矩阵**是所有元素都等于零的 $m\times n$ 矩阵，记作 $0$。

t.en: Note there is a zero matrix for every size. For example, there is a $2\times 3$ zero matrix, a $3\times 4$ zero matrix, and so on.
t.zh: 注意每种大小都有一个零矩阵。例如，有 $2\times 3$ 零矩阵，有 $3\times 4$ 零矩阵，等等。

t.en: The $2\times 3$ zero matrix is $0= \left[\begin{array}{rrr} 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{array}\right]$.
t.zh: $2\times 3$ 零矩阵是 $0= \left[\begin{array}{rrr} 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{array}\right]$。

title.en: Negative of a matrix and subtraction

t.en: The **negative** of a matrix $A=\mat{a_{ij}}$ is defined to be $-A = [-a_{ij}]$. In other words, it is obtained by negating every entry of $A$. To **subtract** two matrices, we simply add the negative of the second matrix to the first one, i.e., $A-B = A+(-B)$. This is just the same as componentwise subtraction.
t.zh: 矩阵 $A=\mat{a_{ij}}$ 的**负矩阵**定义为 $-A = [-a_{ij}]$。换句话说，把 $A$ 的每个元素都取相反数就得到它。要把两个矩阵**相减**，只需把第二个矩阵的负矩阵加到第一个矩阵上，即 $A-B = A+(-B)$。这与按元素逐个相减是一回事。

t.en: Let $A = \left[\begin{array}{rrr} 1 & 2 & -1 \\ -1 & 4 & 0 \\ \end{array}\right]$ and $B = \left[\begin{array}{rrr} 0 & 3 & 0 \\ 1 & -1 & 1 \\ \end{array}\right]$. Find a matrix $X$ such that $(A+X)-(B+0) = B+A$. Hint: first use the properties of matrix addition to simplify the equation and solve for $X$.
t.zh: 设 $A = \left[\begin{array}{rrr} 1 & 2 & -1 \\ -1 & 4 & 0 \\ \end{array}\right]$，$B = \left[\begin{array}{rrr} 0 & 3 & 0 \\ 1 & -1 & 1 \\ \end{array}\right]$。求矩阵 $X$，使得 $(A+X)-(B+0) = B+A$。提示：先用矩阵加法的性质化简方程，再解出 $X$。

t.en: The equation simplifies to $X=B+B$, so $X = \left[\begin{array}{rrr} 0 & 6 & 0 \\ 2 & -2 & 2 \\ \end{array}\right]$.
t.zh: 方程化简为 $X=B+B$，所以 $X = \left[\begin{array}{rrr} 0 & 6 & 0 \\ 2 & -2 & 2 \\ \end{array}\right]$。

t.en: Using only the properties given in Proposition “Properties of matrix addition”, show that if $A+B=0$, then $B=-A$.
t.zh: 只用命题“矩阵加法的性质”给出的性质，证明：若 $A+B=0$，则 $B=-A$。

t.en: Suppose $A+B=0$. Then we have $-A = (-A)+0 = (-A)+(A+B) = ((-A)+A)+B = (A+(-A))+B = 0+B = B+0 = B$. Here, we have used the additive unit law, the assumption $A+B=0$, associativity, commutativity, the additive inverse law, commutativity, and the additive unit law, in that order.
t.zh: 设 $A+B=0$。则有 $-A = (-A)+0 = (-A)+(A+B) = ((-A)+A)+B = (A+(-A))+B = 0+B = B+0 = B$。这里依次用到了：加法单位元律、假设 $A+B=0$、结合律、交换律、加法逆元律、交换律、加法单位元律。

t.en: Using only the properties given in Proposition “Properties of matrix addition”, show $A+B=A$ implies $B=0$.
t.zh: 只用命题“矩阵加法的性质”给出的性质，证明：$A+B=A$ 蕴含 $B=0$。

t.en: Suppose $A+B=A$. Then $B=B+0=0+B=(A+(-A))+B = ((-A)+A)+B = (-A)+(A+B) = (-A)+A = A+(-A) = 0$. Here, we have used the additive unit law, commutativity, the additive inverse law, commutativity, associativity, the assumption $A+B=A$, commutativity, and the additive inverse law, in that order.
t.zh: 设 $A+B=A$。则 $B=B+0=0+B=(A+(-A))+B = ((-A)+A)+B = (-A)+(A+B) = (-A)+A = A+(-A) = 0$。这里依次用到了：加法单位元律、交换律、加法逆元律、交换律、结合律、假设 $A+B=A$、交换律、加法逆元律。
